candidates.name: Bartholin gland carcinoma
support_spans: a painless right vulvar mass extending into the right inguinal region
candidates.why: The patient presents with a painless vulvar mass, which could be indicative of a Bartholin gland carcinoma.

candidates.name: vulvar lipoma
support_spans: a 12 cm, non‐tender mass of the right labia majora
candidates.why: The patient has a non-tender mass in the labia majora, which could be a lipoma.

candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: a painless right vulvar mass extending into the right inguinal region
candidates.why: Kaposi sarcoma can present as a painless mass, although it is less likely given the patient's lack of immunocompromise.

candidates.name: angiomyxoma
support_spans: a well‐defined, hypoechoic solid mass measuring 90 × 44 × 55 mm in the right labia majora
candidates.why: Angiomyxoma is a type of tumor that can present as a well-defined mass, which could explain the patient's symptoms.

candidates.name: canal of Nuck hernia
support_spans: Soft‐tissue ultrasound showed a well‐defined, hypoechoic solid mass measuring 90 × 44 × 55 mm in the right labia majora tracking into the inguinal canal
candidates.why: The ultrasound findings suggest a canal of Nuck hernia, which would be confirmed by imaging.

candidates.name: vulvar fibroma
support_spans: a 12 cm, non‐tender mass of the right labia majora
candidates.why: A biopsy would be necessary to confirm a diagnosis of vulvar fibroma.
